 Smirnoff, Marvel Team Up For 'Avengers: Doomsday' Campaign
 by Teresa Buyikian 
 , 
 Yesterday
 “Avengers: Doomsday” may not hit theaters
until Dec. 18, but a top-selling vodka in the U.S. is already getting ready to promote it.
 Smirnoff this week dropped its “Assemble Your Night” campaign, in collaboration with the
Marvel Studios’ franchise. The effort stars actor Karan Soni, best known for his role as the eager taxi driver Dopinder in Marvel’s “Deadpool” film franchise.
 Soni
appears in various online executions, sneaking onto “Avengers: Doomsday” movie sets to host secret parties featuring themed Smirnoff cocktails inspired by the film, such as the Doomsday
Delight and Fantastic Fizz.
 “Smirnoff is no stranger to culture-defining moments -- we've been partying since 1864 after all -- and there's no bigger moment this side of the multiverse
than ‘Avengers: Doomsday,’” said Jim Ruane, senior vice president, Smirnoff Vodka, in a release. “We've always been about bringing people together across different worlds --
or, in this case, universes. From ‘Doomsday’-inspired cocktails to unexpected experiences for fans, we're bringing that party spirit and giving every type of Marvel fan a reason to
assemble for a celebration in the 616.”
 advertisement
 advertisement
 The highlight of the collaboration will be a “Super House Party,” an event to take place before the film’s Dec. 18 release.
Smirnoff will drop a series of clues revealing the location and other details via its socials leading up to the  party.
 Consumers can also enter to win one of 1800 movie tickets to
“Avengers: Doomsday” (through Fandango promo codes) via Smirnoff’s website, as well a special edition Smirnoff cocktail kit inspired by the film.
 Smirnoff is just the latest
brand to announce an “Avengers: Doomsday” collab; additional promotional partners include Jack in the Box, Dunkin’, Kinder and Regal Cinemas.
